Package com.epitech.depthdiablo.combat

package com.epitech.depthdiablo.combat
Combat: damage formula, hitboxes and hurtboxes, status effects.
  • Related Packages
    Package
    Description
    com.epitech.depthdiablo
     
  • Class
    Description
    AroundContactAttack
    A contact attack that hits all around the owner (GDD 1.3.1): its area is the owner's body box grown by the reach on every side, as an Obb at angle 0 (DECISIONS §5).
    Attack
    What a character's attack does (GDD 1.3.1, 1.6).
    AttackDecorator
    Base of every attack wrapper that a passive item adds (GDD 1.3.1).
    Burn
    A burn (GDD 1.3.1, 1.6): damage over time from fire, such as the fire ring's.
    ContactAttack
    The attack of an enemy that hits at contact, such as a rat or a zombie (GDD 1.3.1): every hostile character whose hurtbox touches its area gets hit.
    Damageable
    Represents an object that can take damage and have a hurtbox.
    DamageFormula
    Computes damage per hit using the formula in GDD 1.6, Q26: damage = max(1, ((attack + attackBonus) x attackBuff) / ((resistance + resistanceBonus) x resistanceBuff)), rounded down.
    DamageOverTime
    Damage over time (GDD 1.3.1, 1.6): deals its damage at the end of every interval until its duration is over.
    DotSpec
    The values of a burn, read from data/items.json (Q93), all counted in logic ticks (60 per second).
    Execute
    Finishes a target that a landed hit leaves under a part of its max HP (GDD 1.3.1).
    Faction
    The side a character fights for (GDD 1.5).
    FireTouch
    Adds a burn to every hit of the wrapped attack that lands (GDD 1.3.1, 1.4.1): a hit that deals no damage, on a dead or invincible target, burns nothing.
    FrontContactAttack
    A contact attack that hits in front of the owner, towards the aim (GDD 1.3.1): its area starts at the centre of the body and goes as far as the reach past the body's edge, whatever the angle.
    Hitbox
    The area of an attack that deals damage (GDD 1.5): a melee swing, a projectile, a trap or a contact attack.
    HitResult
    What one hit did (GDD 1.6): the damage it dealt and whether it killed the target.
    LifeSteal
    Heals the attacker by a part of the damage of every hit that lands (GDD 1.3.1).
    Poison
    A poison (GDD 1.3.1, 1.6): damage over time from venom.
    StatusEffect
    An effect that lasts a number of ticks on a character, such as a burn (GDD 1.3.1, 1.6).
    Swing
    One melee attack in progress (GDD 1.6): the blade of a MeleeWeapon sweeps its arc around the holder, one step per tick, and hits each enemy it touches once.
